faces.name: Descendant of Kiyomaro
faces.oracleText: As long as you have more cards in hand than each opponent, this creature gets +1/+2 and has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage, you gain 3 life."

faces.name: Descendant of Masumaro
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each card in your hand, then remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature for each card in target opponent's hand.

faces.name: Descendant of Soramaro
faces.oracleText: {1}{U}: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of cards in your hand, then put them back in any order.

faces.name: Descendant of Storms
faces.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {1}{W}. If you do, it endures 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on it or create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token.)

faces.name: Descendants' Fury
faces.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice one of them. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card that shares a creature type with the sacrificed creature. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Descendants' Path
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card that shares a creature type with a creature you control, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you don't cast it, put it on the bottom of your library.

faces.name: Descend on the Prey
faces.oracleText: Whenever a Minotaur attacks this turn, it gains first strike until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.

faces.name: Descend upon the Sinful
faces.oracleText:
Exile all creatures.
Delirium — Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
